name: Kitchen
fixed: Wall ovens in tall gray cabinet run
Recessed cans and dropped soffit over island
description: Large kitchen in a 2015 build. Tall high-gloss gray cabinets on the left wall with stacked wall ovens. Back wall has white flat-panel uppers and lowers with a white quartz backsplash. Dark gray gloss island with a waterfall white quartz top and the sink. Light maple floor. Eight recessed cans plus three cylinder pendants on a dropped soffit. Every surface is smooth and reflective.
